method: WebFetch per URL (plus WebSearch and Tavily tavily_extract to locate specific track pages where the manifest URL was a catalog/landing page). Two passes.
pr: PR-Y1.eval-verify-2 (follow-up to PR-Y1.eval-verify #91; depends on PR-Y1.1 / #73)

ruleset.hard_rule: If a row's license cannot be confirmed on a WebFetch-reachable page, leave verification_status='pending' with last_check_at + last_check_note. Never fabricate 'verified'.

entries.notes: FMA artist page returned client_error on two attempts in-session (rate-limit behavior). WebSearch found that Kai Engel's 'Idea' lives as a bandcamp album (https://kaiengel.bandcamp.com/album/idea) with no visible CC license tag on the album page; FMA sibling-album pages (Better_Way, Paradigm_Lost, Irsens_Tale) all deferred to per-track license pages and did not surface a catalog-level CC license. Cannot confirm the specific 'Idea' track is CC BY on an authoritative CC-tagged URL via WebFetch. Keep pending.

PR-Y1.eval-verify-2 replacement for the Kai Engel row (which remained unreachable via WebFetch in this second pass too). Verified Josh Woodward Breadcrumbs album page: 'The songs in this album are licensed under: CC BY' linking to creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/. Track '20/20 (Instrumental Version)' appears at track 4 of the album listing at 03:33 (213s). Album-level verification pattern — same as row 2 Monplaisir (/Free_To_Use) and row 3 Komiku (/ULTRA_PERSON_VOL4). Kept genre=pop (Josh Woodward's instrumental pop catalog).

joshwoodward.com root is reachable but does not name a specific CC version. Verified specific track at https://freemusicarchive.org/music/Josh_Woodward/The_Simple_Life_Part_2_1667/JoshWoodward-TSL-NoVox-207-GoodToGo_1291 — page explicitly says 'licensed under Attribution License' linking to CC BY 4.0 legal code; duration 03:07 (187s), not 200s as recorded in manifest (delta 13s > 5s tolerance). Album page (The_Simple_Life_Part_2_1667) also confirmed 'CC BY 4.0' at album level. Updating url to the specific FMA track URL for reproducibility, updating duration_sec to 187.0, and keeping genre=pop (singer-songwriter instrumental).

Monplaisir artist landing page returned client_error (rate-limit). Verified the album page https://freemusicarchive.org/music/Monplaisir/Free_To_Use — page explicitly states 'The songs in this album are licensed under: CC0 1.0 Universal.' First track 'Free To Use 1' is 03:12 (192s) vs manifest 180s (delta 12s > 5s tolerance). Specifying track 'Free To Use 1' and updating url to album URL (which is where the WebFetch CC0 confirmation lives); the per-track FMA URL /free-to-use-1 returned client_error so is not used. Tolerance delta is documented; license is the gating criterion here (CC0).

Komiku artist landing page loaded but did not name a license (bio string 'Use it how you want' is not a formal license). Verified a specific Komiku album 'ULTRA PERSON VOL4' at https://freemusicarchive.org/music/Komiku/ULTRA_PERSON_VOL4 — page explicitly says 'The songs in this album are licensed under: CC0 1.0 Universal.' Picked 'Level 10 : Finally together' (03:07 / 187s) as the specific cheerful/upbeat pop track; manifest said 165s so delta is 22s > 5s, but license (CC0) is the gating criterion. Also sampled sibling track https://freemusicarchive.org/music/Komiku/Captain_Glouglous_Incredible_Week_Soundtrack/school which also confirmed CC0 1.0 Universal.

incompetech.com/music/royalty-free/music.html loads and names Kevin MacLeod but does not surface a specific CC version in the body (filter UI is JS-rendered). incompetech.com/music/royalty-free/licenses/ only says 'No charge. Requires that you credit the music' — consistent with CC BY but does not name the version. The incompetech License PDF and /wordpress/2014/10/the-new-license/ announcement URLs both returned client_error. Per hard rule, cannot flip to verified without a WebFetch-confirmable CC BY 4.0 (or 3.0) tag on the manifest URL. Keep pending.

PR-Y1.eval-verify-2 replacement for the Kevin MacLeod rock row (which stayed blocked by incompetech's JS-only license surface and whose FMA mirror Rock_Sampler / Rock_Collection / Rockin album URLs returned client_error on multiple attempts in this pass). Verified Jahzzar track page: 'licensed under a Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 International License' (CC BY-SA 3.0), duration 03:10 (190s). Album 'Blinded by Dust' (2011) is self-described as 'the most rocking of the three [Jahzzar albums]', with 'Roads that burned our boots' listed among the powerful-riff rock tracks. License shifted from CC BY 4.0 (manifest's prior desired) to CC BY-SA 3.0 (what's actually confirmable). Kept genre=rock.

audionautix.com root explicitly states: 'The music is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License' (link to CC BY 4.0 legal code). Manifest records 'CC BY 3.0' — version mismatch. Both are in allowed_licenses, so this is a metadata correction rather than a license rejection. However, title is still 'TBD Jason Shaw rock track' and the site's /index.php only shows 'Falling Sky' (house genre, 4:12), not a rock track. No specific rock track was observed via WebFetch in-session, so a specific-track pick cannot be verified yet. Flagging replace_recommended: upstream should (a) correct license to 'CC BY 4.0' and (b) select a specific Audionautix rock track and re-verify. Not flipping to verified without that specific-track confirmation.

PR-Y1.eval-verify-2 replacement for the Audionautix rock row (previously replace_recommended): no specific audionautix.com rock track surfaced via WebFetch in two passes — the root /index.php still rotated to the 'Falling Sky' house track only. Verified Josh Woodward Breadcrumbs instrumental track page: 'licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution License' (CC BY 3.0 per linked badge), duration 04:39 (279s). Driving rock-instrumental from the Breadcrumbs album. License shifted from CC BY 4.0 (manifest's prior desired) to CC BY 3.0. Kept genre=rock.

Jamendo search page body is client-side rendered — WebFetch retrieves only meta tags + GTM, no track listings or license tags. Impossible to verify a license or pick a specific track from this URL via WebFetch alone. Row artist is also TBD, so there is no specific candidate to verify. Keep pending.

PR-Y1.eval-verify-2 replacement for the Jamendo CC BY rock row (Jamendo search remains JS-only in this pass). Verified Josh Woodward Breadcrumbs instrumental track page: 'licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution License' (CC BY 3.0), duration 04:45 (285s). Rock instrumental from the Breadcrumbs album (album-level CC BY 3.0 also confirmed). License shifted from CC BY 4.0 (manifest's prior desired) to CC BY 3.0. Kept genre=rock.
Same as row 6 — Jamendo search page is JS-only. Cannot verify license via WebFetch. Keep pending.

PR-Y1.eval-verify-2 replacement for the Jamendo CC BY-SA rock row (Jamendo search still JS-only). Verified Josh Woodward Breadcrumbs instrumental track page: 'Creative Commons Attribution License' (CC BY 3.0, linked to creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/), duration 04:34 (274s). License shifted from CC BY-SA 4.0 (manifest's prior desired) to CC BY 3.0 — both allowed, but attribution-share-alike is lost; the row's downstream obligation is now straight attribution only. Documented so a reviewer can swap it for a CC BY-SA 4.0 rock track if the share-alike variety is load-bearing for the eval mix.

Lobo Loco artist page shows a 2025 album titled 'Christmas Market / CC-BY' but does not render per-track license tags; attempting the album page https://freemusicarchive.org/music/Lobo_Loco/Christmas_Market__CC-BY returned client_error. The artist is known to have a MIX of CC BY and CC BY-NC-SA, so flipping to verified without a specific CC BY track page confirmation would risk pulling in a CC BY-NC track. Keep pending; the specific track slug must be verified in a follow-up.

PR-Y1.eval-verify-2 replacement for the Lobo Loco folk row: Lobo Loco's CC BY / CC BY-SA album 'FREE FOR YOU - CC BY' is mixed-license and its individual tracks that were WebFetch-reachable in this pass (Queens Shopping Tour, Beach and Surf, Roadtrip to Kansas) all landed in electronic-adjacent genre tags (Easy Listening / Ambient Electronic / Lo-fi Experimental), not folk. Switched artist to Jason Shaw: Audionautix: Acoustic album page confirms 'The songs in this album are licensed under: CC BY' (CC BY 3.0 per linked badge). Album is tagged Country / Folk (explicitly described on FMA as 'a collection of his acoustic, folk, and country tracks'). Track 11 'ACOUSTIC MEDITATION' is 03:14 (194s). Album-level verification pattern — same as row 2 Monplaisir and new row 0 above. License shifted from CC BY 4.0 (manifest's prior desired) to CC BY 3.0. Kept genre=folk.

Jahzzar artist page did not name a catalog license. Verified at track URL https://freemusicarchive.org/music/Jahzzar/Tumbling_Dishes_Like_Old-Mans_Wishes/Step_On — explicitly 'Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 (CC BY-SA 4.0)', duration 03:01 (181s). Manifest said 180s — within ±5s tolerance. Updating url to the specific track URL, title to 'Step On', fma_id to 'jahzzar-tumbling-dishes-step-on', and duration_sec to 181.0.
Jazz-filtered incompetech page loads but shows 'No Track selected.' and no track list (filter widget is JS). Same license-surface issue as row 4. Keep pending.

PR-Y1.eval-verify-2 replacement URL for the Kevin MacLeod jazz row: incompetech still JS-only, but the FMA mirror Jazz_Sampler album page explicitly surfaces 'The songs in this album are licensed under: Attribution 3.0 International' (CC BY 3.0) — AND the specific track page https://freemusicarchive.org/music/Kevin_MacLeod/Jazz_Sampler/Dances_and_Dames explicitly says 'Dances and Dames by Kevin MacLeod is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution License' (badge → creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/), duration 02:26 (146s). License corrected from CC BY 4.0 → CC BY 3.0 (both allowed; matches what the page actually shows). Kept genre=jazz.

usarmyband.com returned client_error — WebFetch could not retrieve the page. Cannot confirm 'US Government public domain' claim or any specific recording. Keep pending; may require a direct .gov/.mil access path from an unauthenticated proxy, or a replacement with a USAF/Navy band recording hosted somewhere WebFetch can reach.

PR-Y1.eval-verify-2 replacement for the US Army Blues Public Domain row: usarmyband.com still returned client_error in this pass and no equivalent WebFetch-reachable .mil/.gov PD jazz site could be substituted (marineband.marines.mil also failed for row 15). Switched to Kevin MacLeod's Jazz Sampler, a second track from the same CC BY 3.0 album as row 10. Verified track page: 'As I Figure by Kevin MacLeod is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution License' (CC BY 3.0), duration 03:36 (216s). License shifted from Public Domain to CC BY 3.0 — both allowed; the row now carries a downstream attribution obligation (which was already the policy for the row 1 / row 10 Kevin MacLeod rows). Kept genre=jazz.

Dexter Britain FMA page did not show a catalog-level license and directed to the artist's own site (dexterbritain.com/info/#creative-commons) for current terms. A sibling-album probe (freemusicarchive.org/music/Dexter_Britain/The_Tempest) returned client_error. The artist is known to have shifted some later releases to CC BY-NC, so flipping to verified without a specific CC BY-SA 3.0 track page confirmation is unsafe. Keep pending.

PR-Y1.eval-verify-2 replacement for the Dexter Britain electronic row: cross-checked that ALL of Dexter Britain's Creative Commons Volumes (1 through 5) carry CC BY-NC-SA (archive.org mirror for Volume 5 shows the NC/SA badges; musicbed also lists Creative_Commons_Vol_1 as a themed compilation) — meaning the manifest's hoped-for CC BY-SA 3.0 was never a safe pin for this artist. Switched to Lobo Loco's FREE FOR YOU - CC BY album, which is mixed CC BY + CC BY-SA 4.0 (so track-level verification is mandatory). Verified track page: 'Queens Shopping Tour (ID 2333) by Lobo Loco is licensed under a Attribution 4.0 International License' (CC BY 4.0), duration 03:22 (202s). Track-page genre tags are Easy Listening / Ambient Electronic / Lo-fi Experimental — electronic-adjacent, acceptable for the electronic slot. License corrected from CC BY-SA 3.0 → CC BY 4.0.

Podington Bear artist page loaded but surfaced no catalog-level license (only linked to an FMA 'License guide'). Artist catalog is known to mix CC BY-NC and CC BY-SA, so flipping to verified without a specific CC BY-SA track page is unsafe. Keep pending.

PR-Y1.eval-verify-2 replacement for the Podington Bear electronic row: cross-checked that Podington Bear's two FMA box set albums 'Meet Podington Bear (Box Set Disc 1)' and 'Liquid Gold (Box Set Disc 2)' are BOTH CC BY-NC per their album pages — meaning the manifest's hoped-for CC BY-SA 3.0 was never a safe pin for this artist either (same failure mode as row 12 Dexter Britain). Switched to Lobo Loco's FREE FOR YOU - CC BY album. Verified track page: carries the CC BY 4.0 license badge (https://licensebuttons.net/l/by/4.0/88x31.png) directly on the track page. Duration 04:49 (289s) per the album index. License corrected from CC BY-SA 3.0 → CC BY 4.0.

Not re-fetched in-session — incompetech's main music.html and filter variants (rows 4 and 10) surfaced no specific CC version via WebFetch, and incompetech's license announcement URLs returned client_error. Treating this row as identically blocked. Keep pending.

PR-Y1.eval-verify-2 replacement URL for the Kevin MacLeod classical row: FMA mirror Classical_Sampler album page explicitly surfaces 'The songs in this album are licensed under: Attribution 3.0 International' (CC BY 3.0) — AND the specific track page says 'Canon in D Major by Kevin MacLeod is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution License' (link to creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/), duration 05:55 (355s). Pachelbel-style triadic classical — baseline classical test case. License corrected from CC BY 4.0 → CC BY 3.0.
marineband.marines.mil returned client_error. Cannot confirm US Government public-domain status or any specific recording via WebFetch. Keep pending.

PR-Y1.eval-verify-2 replacement for the US Marine Band Public Domain classical row: marineband.marines.mil still returned client_error in this pass and no equivalent WebFetch-reachable PD classical site (musopen.org / Wikimedia Commons) could be pinned with a specific track URL in-session. Verified Kevin MacLeod track page: 'Calmant by Kevin MacLeod is licensed under a Attribution 3.0 International License' (CC BY 3.0), duration 03:24 (204s). Soft solo-piano classical — complements the Canon in D row. License shifted from Public Domain to CC BY 3.0 — both allowed; downstream attribution obligation is now explicit.
Jamendo search page is JS-only (same as rows 6, 7, 17). No listings or license tags visible via WebFetch. Row artist is TBD. Keep pending.

PR-Y1.eval-verify-2 replacement for the Jamendo world/latin wildcard row (Jamendo search still JS-only). Verified Lobo Loco track page: carries the CC BY-SA 4.0 license badge (https://licensebuttons.net/l/by-sa/4.0/88x31.png) directly on the track page. Duration 06:03 (363s) per the album index. Americana-roadtrip feel (consistent with the wildcard slot's non-standard-progression intent). License shifted from CC BY 4.0 (manifest's prior desired) to CC BY-SA 4.0 — both allowed; the downstream obligation is attribution + share-alike.

Still pending after PR-Y1.eval-verify-2. Jamendo search URL remains JS-only — WebFetch sees only meta tags, no track listings or license tags. Candidates attempted and discarded in this session: (a) Jahzzar 'Overdose' — breakingcopyright.com lists it as Metal/Rock but no FMA URL for 'Overdose' surfaced in either Tavily search or WebFetch; (b) Jahzzar 'Super' album URL (https://freemusicarchive.org/music/Jahzzar/Super) returned client_error; (c) Jahzzar 'Blinded by Dust' heavier tracks ('Magic Mountain', 'Scream from a Deaf Man', 'Driver') returned 404 via Tavily extract (slug mismatches — only 'Roads that burned our boots' resolved). FMA has no clean CC BY-SA 4.0 'Metal' genre album with a WebFetch-reachable track page that was confirmable in this session. Follow-up PR-Y1.eval-verify-3 should either (1) manually resolve a Jahzzar 'Super' or 'Overdose' track slug and WebFetch-verify its CC BY-SA 4.0 license, or (2) replace this row with a verified CC BY-SA 4.0 heavy-rock track from another FMA artist in the wildcard slot. The wildcard-metal row is the only row holding back the gate to 20/20.

FMA Ambient genre page lists artist names (Anemoia, Jon Shuemaker, amholt, Joseph Sacco, Mark Lingard) but no per-track license tags render in the fetched body. Row artist is TBD. Cannot pick + verify a specific CC BY ambient track from the manifest URL alone. Keep pending.

PR-Y1.eval-verify-2 replacement URL for the FMA Ambient wildcard row: Kevin MacLeod Calming album page explicitly surfaces 'The songs in this album are licensed under: Attribution 3.0 International' (CC BY 3.0) — AND the specific track page explicitly says 'licensed under a Attribution 3.0 International License', duration 03:32 (212s). Sparse, slow, minimal-harmony solo piano meditation — stresses the 'N' (no chord) output when there's no clear harmony. License shifted from CC BY 4.0 → CC BY 3.0.
FMA Folk genre page loaded but no per-track license tags render. Only 'Acoustic dream' by Melomaker surfaced in the Acoustic cross-tag with no license info. Row artist is TBD. Keep pending.

PR-Y1.eval-verify-2 replacement URL for the FMA Folk wildcard acoustic row: Jason Shaw Audionautix: Acoustic album page confirms 'The songs in this album are licensed under: CC BY' (CC BY 3.0). Track 1 'PIONEERS' is 02:53 (173s) per the album index. Solo acoustic guitar — stand-in for upload-only own-file mode (no drums/bass, closest to a lone-instrument harmonic probe). Same album-level verification pattern as row 2 Monplaisir and the two new Josh Woodward / Audionautix Acoustic rows (0 and 8). License shifted from CC BY 4.0 → CC BY 3.0.

fetch_notes: freemusicarchive.org continues to return client_error on many /music/<Artist>/ landing pages, but specific /music/<Artist>/<Album>/ album pages and /music/<Artist>/<Album>/<Track> track pages generally load when the slug is exact. Tavily's tavily_extract succeeded on several pages FMA's WebFetch bounced in-session — use it as a fallback when a per-track WebFetch bounces.

Jamendo search pages are irrevocably client-side rendered; neither WebFetch nor tavily_extract (on the search URL) surfaces track listings or license tags. Only a direct jamendo.com/track/<id> URL would be verifiable, and those IDs are not discoverable from the search filter URL.

incompetech.com surfaces only 'free with attribution' prose; it does not name the CC version in rendered HTML. All three Kevin MacLeod manifest rows were moved to their FMA mirrors (Jazz_Sampler / Classical_Sampler / Calming) where per-track CC BY 3.0 license tags render in the fetched body.

Dexter Britain's 'Creative Commons Volume X' compilations are ALL CC BY-NC-SA per archive.org mirrors — the manifest's prior CC BY-SA 3.0 pin was never achievable. Same failure mode for Podington Bear's box-set discs on FMA (CC BY-NC).

.mil band sites (usarmyband.com, marineband.marines.mil) still returned client_error in this pass. US Government PD recordings are theoretically ideal for the eval, but only when they live on a WebFetch-reachable mirror; both PD rows were replaced with CC BY 3.0 Kevin MacLeod tracks.

gate_status.reason: 19/20 rows verified against a WebFetch-reachable CC license page (up from 4/20 in PR-Y1.eval-verify). Row 17 (wildcard-metal) is still pending — no WebFetch-confirmable CC BY-SA 4.0 metal track could be substituted in this session. Per the manifest's hard rule ('CHORD_EVAL_FETCH=1 stays gated until every row is verified'), the CI flag should remain off until row 17 is resolved. However, the README's 'gate open' progress marker is updated to reflect 19/20 (≥18/20) so reviewers can see the second verification pass brought the gate most of the way open.
gate_status.next_action: PR-Y1.eval-verify-3: resolve or replace row 17 (CC BY-SA 4.0 metal wildcard). Candidate paths listed in the row's last_check_note.
